task_description: Write a method in Dafny to check whether the product of numbers in an array is even or not.
specification_response:
Method Signature:
    method IsProductEven(arr: array<int>) returns (result: bool)
Postconditions_prompt:
    - The result is true if and only if the product of all numbers in the input array is even
    - The result is false if and only if the product of all numbers in the input array is odd
